request.text: wardog's PowerShell on WORKSTATION5 dropped an HTA into the Startup folder and ran it with mshta, which started a shell. Disable account wardog.

package.rationale: wardog's elevated PowerShell (PID 10848) reached 151.101.208.133:443, wrote T1218.005.hta into wardog's Startup folder and ran it with mshta.exe (PID 9160); mshta then opened and started cmd.exe. A malicious HTA runs now and at every logon; disable wardog.
